# Summary

This paper presents a novel methodology that simultaneously performs feature selection and classification on longitudinal functional data with categorical outcomes, using an adaptive Dual Augmented Lagrangian algorithm with functional principal components for computational efficiency. The approach is validated through simulations and a real-world application examining relationships between chronic diseases and health/socio-demographic factors.
